verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a mobile app for search and capture on the go, and says search works offline on all devices. However, its own docs describe the mobile app as "a companion to desktop", which contradicts the story's "not a stripped-down companion" framing. Missing for 10: explicit iOS and Android parity with desktop, evidence of linking/backlinks/block references working on mobile, full knowledge-base feature coverage on mobile, and independent hands-on corroboration.
